feeds.title: My Northern Garden
feeds.description: I am Mary. I'm a freelance writer and editor by trade and about a decade ago I got a freelance gig editing Northern Gardener, the publication of the Minnesota State Horticultural Society. That job, plus lots of trial and error in my garden in Northfield, Minnesota, prompted me to start this blog, where I share how-tos, plant information, recipes, book recommendations, and fun.
